name: CELESTIA
description: CELESTIA - The Most Beautiful WhatsApp Bot | Heavenly Automation | VPS Hostable | Baileys | Inspired by WolfTech

SESSION_ID.description: WhatsApp session string (CELESTIA:~... format). Get it from the pairing site or the bot's first-link DM backup. Treat like a password.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Owner WhatsApp number, digits only with country code, no + (e.g. 2547XXXXXXXX). Only this number gets owner powers.

TIMEZONE.description: IANA timezone for schedules, herald briefing and rituals.

PAIR_MODE.description: Set to 'true' for cloud pairing: the app prints a pairing code in the logs instead of booting the bot. Link it, then flip back to 'false' and redeploy.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Powers AI features (.ai, roast engine AI path).

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Powers AI features via Gemini.

BOT_SETTINGS_DATA.description: Optional. Base64 bot-settings backup (restored on boot).

DASHBOARD_API_KEY.description: Optional. Shared secret for the dashboard x-api-key header.

LOG_LEVEL.description: Log verbosity: silent, error, warn, info, debug.
